description: A BCA Tahapan Gold account holder in Bandung had their Telkomsel SIM card fraudulently swapped at an authorized dealer outlet in Bekasi using a forged KTP (national ID). Within 2 hours of the SIM swap, the attacker received OTP SMS for BCA mobile banking login and successfully changed the transaction PIN. A total of IDR 95,000,000 was transferred in two transactions — IDR 50,000,000 to an account at Bank Neo Commerce and IDR 45,000,000 to a GoPay wallet — before the legitimate account holder noticed loss of cellular signal and reported to Telkomsel. The KTP used at the dealer had the victim's name but a different photo and fabricated NIK number. BCA's fraud detection flagged the login from a new device in a different province but the OTP confirmation bypassed the alert.
